title: mitigation mantel haenszel
summary: A mitigation and control are compared within two traffic tiers. Tier 1: mitigation has 8 incidents and 92 non-incidents; control has 20 incidents and 80 non-incidents. Tier 2: mitigation has 30 incidents and 70 non-incidents; control has 45 incidents and 55 non-incidents. The team must estimate one common incident odds ratio adjusted for tier, using the full 2x2 strata rather than pooling all traffic first.
